title: Covariance of two functions
statement: Let $\Omega$ be a finite set and let $f,g\colon\Omega\to\mathbb R$. Their covariance is the mean over $\Omega$ of $(f(x)-\operatorname{mean}(f))(g(x)-\operatorname{mean}(g))$.
